decisions.reason: As a mitred door lever handle family it fits the firm's core handle-making knowledge and its continued website presence through 2024 suggests enough market feedback and internal know-how to refine rather than withdraw it.

The multifunctional door lever handle builds directly on the firm's established competencies and its own page in 2024 indicates the firm sees sufficient value and learning potential to continue commercialising it.

This door lever handle remains close to the firm's existing product and production base, but because it is only mentioned rather than strongly featured, it carries a somewhat higher rationalisation risk despite likely being kept.

The door and window handle collection is highly aligned with the firm's accumulated knowledge and the repeated dedicated promotion plus major design awards make withdrawal within a year very unlikely.
